title: John D Probable NDE 4836
content: I do not remember this experience now, but my parents and my cousins remember how I described the experience to them when I was approximately four years old. On a beach trip, I insisted that every family member play 'operation' with me. I asked them to lay down on the floor, and then I went through a long series of motions, moving back and forth between their chest and an imaginary table. At the end of the 'operation', I always said something like, 'You are all better now.' When asked about how I knew how to play operation, I was very matter of fact in saying that 'I remembered my operation.' My mother said that she was concerned by this answer and asked what I remembered. I told her that during my operation I went to live with God. She asked more - what happened when I went to live with God? I told her that God said I was supposed to go back and live with my Mom and Dad for a long time, before I would come back to live with him. My Mom asked if I was scared, and my response was something like, 'How could I be scared of God?' I wish I remembered the experience myself, but my Mom's memory of the way I described things is still very clear. It was shortly after this that our next door neighbor died of cancer. My mother recalls how distraught I was that in this case 'Randy' went to live with God, but didn't get to come back to his wife Janice. I insisted that I needed to talk to Janice, and so my Mother and I visited. My Mother remembers that the message I had to give to Janice, was that Randy went to live with God and so he was okay.

elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I do not fear the loss of loved ones. Since I was a baby, my favorite person has been my grandfather. He is now becoming feeble with old age - at eighty-five years of age I know I know I won't have him in my life forever. I will miss him every day after he is gone, but will not fear his loss. I believe he will be waiting for me when I join him, to live with God.
